checks.name: qs5_exact_gate_source_bound
checks.cmd:
python3 - <<'QS5_GATE_PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('results/rtl/dsrom_qelem_pq_20261006/qx10qs5_recovery_gate.json');raw=p.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()=='44f6c76d27d95b83e0e4bdb57241121c91672d4eb816de27f21038b3cbd4f33b'
g=json.loads(raw);assert g['verdict']=='PASS' and g['total_compared_cycles']==12775002
pos=[x for x in g['runs'] if x['name'].startswith('pos')]
neg=[x for x in g['runs'] if x['name'].startswith('neg')]
assert len(pos)==5 and len(neg)==3
assert all(x['returncode']==0 and x['coverage']['compared_cycles']>0 for x in pos)
assert all(x['returncode']!=0 and x['caught'] for x in neg)
for f,h in g['source_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h, f
print('QS5_GATE_BOUND_PASS sources=%d positives=5 negatives=3 cycles=12775002'%len(g['source_sha256']))
QS5_GATE_PY
